results.scope: Triple systems are finite families of 3-element sets on an arbitrary vertex type with decidable equality; Berge triangles are non-induced with distinct vertices and distinct edges; saturation quantifies over every absent 3-element set. A paired product has disjoint 2-element pairs and a disjoint base that together cover every vertex, with at least one pair and one base vertex.
Every paired product on every vertex type is Berge-triangle-free and saturated; it has #pairs * #base edges, and 2 * #pairs + #base equals the number of vertices of a finite vertex type.
